get.description: This API endpoint will return all jobs that are setup in WinTeam. Optionally this list can be filtered by Location.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The location identifier you want to filter the list of jobs.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The size of the page.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: searchFieldName
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to search records by. Possible values are: "jobNumber", "parentJobNumber", "jobId", "jobDescription", "companyNumber", "lighthouseApplication", "hoursRuleId, "jobJoinedDescription"

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The text you’ll search for in results from the "SearchFieldName" you’ve specified.

parameters.name: exactMatch
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the comparison on the search text value will be exact. (false by default)

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to sort records by. Possible values are: "jobNumber", "parentJobNumber", "jobId", "jobDescription", "companyNumber", "lighthouseApplication", "hoursRuleId", "jobJoinedDescription"

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the order should be ascending (true) or descending (false)

parameters.description: We'll provide a description of what this value represents and how to obtain one.

Description.description:
The system uses this Description in Timekeeping, Budgeting, and Personnel Scheduling pertaining to this Job.
            The field can contain information specific only to this Job, such as Restroom Cleaner, Day Porter, Utility Cleaner, etc.

Salaried.description:
Select this field as true if the Description is for a salaried employee.
            Set this field as true only if you want the system to show these salaried hours and labor dollars in both the Actual and Budgeted areas of the Hours Budget Comparison Report.
            It will also add to the Actuals on the Job Cost Analysis Report.

BillRate.description:
Use the Bill Rate field to view or enter the billable rate if this Job is billed by the hour.
            The Hours Type must have an Hourly Bill Revenue # associated in order to add a Bill Rate.

PayRate.description: Use the Pay Rate field to view or enter the rate for the system to use for this position in the Job Cost Report and On Screen Job Cost, which calculate the Daily Budgets for this Job.

results.notes: This area is for note regarding this job

JobId.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier for the job. If not provided, a new GUID will be generated.

CompanyNumber.description: Gets or sets the company number associated with this job.

IsAvalaraClient.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the client is using Avalara AvaTax for sales tax calculation.

HoursRuleId.description: Gets or sets the hours rule ID that defines overtime and other hour calculation rules for this job.

Active.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this job is active. Defaults to true if not specified.

DateToStart.description: Gets or sets the date when work on this job is scheduled to start.

ReviewDate.description: Gets or sets the date when this job should be reviewed.

DiscontinueDate.description: Gets or sets the date when this job was discontinued. Required when Active is false.

ServiceExpirationDate.description: Gets or sets the date when the service contract for this job expires.

ParentJobNumber.description: Gets or sets the parent job number if this is a sub-job. Maximum length: 10 characters.

Notes.description: Gets or sets general notes about this job. Maximum length: 250 characters.

Directions.description: Gets or sets directions to the job site. No maximum length.

Keys.description: Gets or sets information about keys needed to access the job site. No maximum length.

Salutation.description: Gets or sets the salutation for the job contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Maximum length: 50 characters.

ContactNameFirst.description: Gets or sets the first name of the primary contact for this job. Maximum length: 50 characters.

ContactNameLast.description: Gets or sets the last name of the primary contact for this job. Maximum length: 50 characters.

ContactTitle.description: Gets or sets the job title of the primary contact. Maximum length: 50 characters.

Phone1.description: Gets or sets the primary phone number. Must be exactly 10 numeric digits with no formatting characters (e.g., '5551234567').

Phone1Description.description: Gets or sets a description for the primary phone number (e.g., "Main Office", "Emergency"). Maximum length: 50 characters.

Phone2.description: Gets or sets the secondary phone number. Must be exactly 10 numeric digits with no formatting characters (e.g., '5551234567').

Phone2Description.description: Gets or sets a description for the secondary phone number. Maximum length: 50 characters.

Phone3.description: Gets or sets the tertiary phone number. Must be exactly 10 numeric digits with no formatting characters (e.g., '5551234567').

Phone3Description.description: Gets or sets a description for the tertiary phone number. Maximum length: 50 characters.

EmailAddress.description: Gets or sets the email address for the job contact. Maximum length: 100 characters.

PONumber.description: Gets or sets the purchase order number for this job. Maximum length: 50 characters.

MarkupMethod.description: Gets or sets the markup calculation method for billing (e.g., 1=Standard, 2=Enhanced).

MarkupPercent.description: Gets or sets the markup percentage to apply to costs for billing calculations.

IncludePSDetailsonInvoice.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include professional services details on the invoice.

CustomerNumber.description: Gets or sets the customer number associated with this job. Maximum length: 8 characters.

ItemGroupID.description: Gets or sets the item group ID for categorizing items used on this job.

PrintTimesheet.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to print timesheets for this job. Defaults to false.

ATMJob.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this job exports time data to ATM/TeamTime systems.

HolidayMethod.description: Gets or sets the holiday calculation method (e.g., 1=Standard List, 2=Custom).

SplitShiftMethod.description: Gets or sets the split shift calculation method (e.g., 1=Standard Method, 2=Alternative).

SplitShiftStartTime.description: Gets or sets the time when a new day begins for split shift calculations. Must be between midnight and 8:00 AM.

WeeklyContractedRegHours.description: Gets or sets the weekly contracted regular hours for employees on this job.

WeeklyContractedOTHours.description: Gets or sets the weekly contracted overtime hours for employees on this job.

HoursWorkedFrom1.description: Gets or sets the starting hours threshold for the first deduction range.

HoursWorkedTo1.description: Gets or sets the ending hours threshold for the first deduction range.

HoursToDeduct1.description: Gets or sets the hours to deduct in the first range (e.g., lunch break).

HoursWorkedFrom2.description: Gets or sets the starting hours threshold for the second deduction range.

HoursWorkedTo2.description: Gets or sets the ending hours threshold for the second deduction range.

HoursToDeduct2.description: Gets or sets the hours to deduct in the second range.

HoursWorkedFrom3.description: Gets or sets the starting hours threshold for the third deduction range.

HoursWorkedTo3.description: Gets or sets the ending hours threshold for the third deduction range.

HoursToDeduct3.description: Gets or sets the hours to deduct in the third range.

ForceBudgetsToActual.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to force budgets to match actual costs. Defaults to false.

ForceBudgetsDateFrom.description: Gets or sets the start date for forcing budgets to actual. Must be less than or equal to ForceBudgetsDateTo.

ForceBudgetsDateTo.description: Gets or sets the end date for forcing budgets to actual. Must be greater than or equal to ForceBudgetsDateFrom.

ForceActualToBudgets.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to force actual costs to match budgets. Defaults to false.

ServicesTaxable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether services on this job are taxable.

ProductsTaxable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether products on this job are taxable.

Taxable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this job is taxable. Defaults to true.

TaxabilityByJob.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether tax rules are determined by the job location rather than company settings.

UsePrimaryServiceLocationForSalesTax.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use the primary service location for sales tax calculations instead of the job address.

TaxExemptID.description: Gets or sets the tax exemption certificate ID for this job. Maximum length: 25 characters.

TaxExemptExpirationDate.description: Gets or sets the expiration date of the tax exemption certificate.

SalesTaxCountyID.description: Gets or sets the sales tax county ID for tax calculation.

SalesTaxCityID.description: Gets or sets the sales tax city ID for tax calculation.

SalesTaxLocal1ID.description: Gets or sets the first local sales tax ID for additional local tax jurisdictions.

SalesTaxLocal2ID.description: Gets or sets the second local sales tax ID for additional local tax jurisdictions.

SalesTaxLocal3ID.description: Gets or sets the third local sales tax ID for additional local tax jurisdictions.

EugeneCSPTTax.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this job is subject to Eugene CSP Tax.

PrintJobCostReport.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to print the job cost report. Defaults to true.

PrintJobCostScreen.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to display job cost information on screen. Defaults to true.

UseDatedTiers.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this job uses dated tiers for historical tier tracking.

example.Directions: Take I-90 East, exit at Main St

EffectiveDate.description: Use the Effective Date to enter or view the beginning date for this budget history record. The system lists records in ascending order, with the most current record at the top of the list.

Notes.description: Use the Notes field to enter any notes pertaining to this budget record. The system will automatically record auditable information in this field.

Details.description: The Budget Details array contains the budgeted hours and rate for the employees who work at this Job. The system uses this information in the Job Cost report and the On Screen Job Cost Report.
